skills.name: seihou-scaffold-kit-skill
skills.description: Scaffold new Claude Code skills and agents for Seihou, following established conventions.

skills.name: seihou-module-readme
skills.description: Write or refresh a short README.md for a Seihou module, recipe, blueprint, or prompt that points to its page in the registry's generated OKF documentation bundle.

skills.name: seihou-prune-orphan-modules
skills.description: Diagnose and clear stale orphan module records from a project's .seihou/manifest.json that pollute `seihou status` (phantom applied modules and spurious pending migrations from modules owning no files, links, or seeds). Use on old repos showing leftovers the CLI cannot retire.
